coverage.note: Singleton (Wise, wise.jobs on Attrax). The Attrax job page has no form; its 'Apply' links (/Workflow?workflowId=...&vacancyId=4069) redirect to SmartRecruiters 'Easy apply' (jobs.smartrecruiters.com/oneclick-ui/...). The SmartRecruiters form is built from web components (shadow DOM); a shadow-DOM walker captured the blank fields. Backend actually observed: smartrecruiters (mapped by worker fable_b); fields recorded here as evidence of the redirect destination.
